description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to facilitate the registration of grain storage providers within Orleans runtime hosting environment. It defines a method AddGrainStorage that adds a grain storage implementation, with optional lifecycle participation if the provider implements ILifecycleParticipant<ISiloLifecycle>.

classes.name: StorageProviderExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension method for IServiceCollection to add grain storage providers to Orleans silo

methods.name: AddGrainStorage
methods.description: Registers a grain storage provider with the dependency injection container, optionally adding lifecycle participation if the provider supports it.
